entries.english: Open the Campinas agricultural office directory from Brazil’s country review.
entries.st: Bula bukana ea liofisi tsa temo tsa Campinas ho tsoa tlhahlobong ea naha ea Brazil.
entries.ts: Pfula dayirekitari ya tihofisi ta vurimi ta Campinas ku suka eka nhlelo wa tiko ra Brazil.
entries.ve: Vulani mutevhe wa ofisi dza vhulimi dza Campinas u bva kha tsedzuluso ya shango la Brazil.
entries.zu: Vula uhla lwamahhovisi ezolimo ase-Campinas kusuka ekubuyekezweni kwezwe lase-Brazil.

entries.st: Fumana bukana ea liofisi tsa Campinas
entries.ts: Kuma dayirekitari ya tihofisi ta Campinas
entries.ve: Wanani mutevhe wa ofisi dza Campinas

entries.english: Choose Brazil and open Agricultural extension to find the Campinas directory.
entries.st: Kgetha Brazil ebe o bula Keletso ea temo ho fumana bukana ea Campinas.
entries.ts: Hlawula Brazil kutani u pfula Switsundzuxo swa vurimi ku kuma dayirekitari ya Campinas.
entries.ve: Nangani Brazil ni vule Nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi u itela u wana mutevhe wa Campinas.
entries.zu: Khetha i-Brazil bese uvula Ezolimo zokweluleka ukuze uthole uhla lwe-Campinas.
